title: Preservation of existing auxiliary coordinates
statement: Let $a$ and $K$ be natural numbers with $a\le K$, and let $u:\{0,1\}^a\to\{-1,1\}$ be an auxiliary sign assignment. After extending $u$ to $K$ coordinates by retaining its first $a$ coordinates and filling the rest with $-1$, its value at coordinate $i$ is $u(i)$ for every $i\in\{0,1\}^a$.
hypotheses_covered: $u$ is a sign assignment on $a$ coordinates
$i$ is an index among the first $a$ coordinates
